Architecture overview for the ingestion pipeline

This first page describes the deterministic export contract in enough words to give the completeness check real material to sample from. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the pipeline keeps every byte accounted for.

Second page: retention and replay semantics

Replay windows are bounded by the retention ledger, and the final sentence of this fixture is deliberately memorable so the tail sample always lands on it: the last row of the ledger is never evicted.
